title: Lions pass rusher Aidan Hutchinson is out for the season with a torn ACL, NFL Network reports
dek: He was hurt celebrating a sack in Munich on Sunday. It is the second time in three years an injury has ended his season.
what: NFL Network reports that Detroit Lions defensive end Aidan Hutchinson tore the ACL in his right knee and will miss the rest of the 2026 season, with possible meniscus damage. The reporters are Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo. The league's site says he was hurt in the first half of the Lions' 35-10 win over the New England Patriots in Munich on Sunday, 15 November, landing from a jump while celebrating a third-down sack of Drake Maye.

A short video of the moment was among the first posts to spread. On Sunday evening Rapoport posted that Hutchinson was feared to have a significant knee injury. On Monday ESPN's Adam Schefter posted that initial tests showed a torn ACL.

The NFL.com report says Hutchinson had six sacks, 19 quarterback hits and 50 pressures this season, and that the Lions are 7-2. It also notes he missed 12 games in 2024 with a broken tibia and fibula. It quotes no Lions statement. He had an MRI in Munich and further tests in the United States. The injury is described as initial; any further damage is not confirmed.
why: A star player hurt in a moment of celebration, in front of a global audience at the league's Germany game, with a video that anyone could replay.
next: A Lions statement or surgery date, once the team gives one.

sources.label: NFL.com: Hutchinson out for 2026 season with torn ACL
